lZ6|$ROuY@4g|4a0LSm=.text:
Dude please make a designated animation player instead of the huge list of broadcasts you have now

How to do this:

Have a custom "Set Animation" block that sets an internal variable for what animation to play (based on a string input from the block) and then broadcasts "Sonic Set Animation"

Then have a receiving block for said broadcast in your sprite, that when activated runs a "Load Animation" custom block.

In that custom block have an if statement for every single animation you want to use, and inside each if statement for every animation have the costume scripts to play said animation

TL;DR: copy the animation player from here:
https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/297849122/
